hooks.command: command -v lane >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec lane --reset; exit 0
command -v tier-reconcile >/dev/null 2>&1 && tier-reconcile >/dev/null 2>&1; true
command -v cost-mirror >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec cost-mirror; [ -x "$HOME/.claude/hooks/cost-mirror" ] && exec "$HOME/.claude/hooks/cost-mirror"; exit 0

e=$(grep -m1 '^model:' "$HOME/.claude/agents/executor.md" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^model:[[:space:]]*//'); s=$(grep -m1 '^model:' "$HOME/.claude/agents/scout.md" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^model:[[:space:]]*//'); d=$(command -v lane >/dev/null 2>&1 && lane --prime --short 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$d" ]; then d=" · $d"; else d=" — dispatch: recon→scout · slices→executor · claims→verifier · trivial→inline"; fi; [ -n "$e" ] && echo "[tier] worker=$e recon=${s:-?}$d"; true
bd prime
command -v context-detect >/dev/null 2>&1 && context-detect; true
command -v code-map-prime >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-map-prime; true
command -v disk-cleanup >/dev/null 2>&1 && (disk-cleanup >/dev/null 2>&1 &); true
command -v tier-reconcile >/dev/null 2>&1 && tier-reconcile >/dev/null 2>&1; true

r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$r" ] && [ -x "$r/scripts/tier-prime.sh" ] && { "$r/scripts/tier-prime.sh" 2>/dev/null; exit 0; }; command -v tier-prime >/dev/null 2>&1 && { tier-prime 2>/dev/null; exit 0; }; [ -x "$HOME/.claude/hooks/tier-prime" ] && { "$HOME/.claude/hooks/tier-prime" 2>/dev/null; exit 0; }; exit 0

r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$r" ] && [ -x "$r/scripts/image-drift.py" ] && { "$r/scripts/image-drift.py" 2>/dev/null; exit 0; }; command -v image-drift >/dev/null 2>&1 && { image-drift 2>/dev/null; exit 0; }; [ -x "$HOME/.claude/hooks/image-drift" ] && { "$HOME/.claude/hooks/image-drift" 2>/dev/null; exit 0; }; exit 0

r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$r" ] && [ -x "$r/scripts/cost-mirror.py" ] && { timeout 3 python3 "$r/scripts/cost-mirror.py" --refresh-pricing >/dev/null 2>&1 & exit 0; }; c=$(command -v cost-mirror 2>/dev/null) && "$c" --help 2>/dev/null | grep -q refresh-pricing && { timeout 3 "$c" --refresh-pricing >/dev/null 2>&1 & exit 0; }; exit 0
bd prime

r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$r" ] && [ -x "$r/scripts/tier-prime.sh" ] && { "$r/scripts/tier-prime.sh" --full 2>/dev/null; exit 0; }; command -v tier-prime >/dev/null 2>&1 && { tier-prime --full 2>/dev/null; exit 0; }; [ -x "$HOME/.claude/hooks/tier-prime" ] && { "$HOME/.claude/hooks/tier-prime" --full 2>/dev/null; exit 0; }; exit 0
mkdir -p /home/agent/.claude/exported-logs && cp ~/.claude/debug/latest /home/agent/.claude/exported-logs/last-session.log 2>/dev/null || true
command -v bd-guard >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec bd-guard; exit 0
command -v contract-gate >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec contract-gate; [ -x "$HOME/.claude/hooks/contract-gate" ] && exec "$HOME/.claude/hooks/contract-gate"; exit 0
command -v tier-gate >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec tier-gate; [ -x "$HOME/.claude/hooks/tier-gate" ] && exec "$HOME/.claude/hooks/tier-gate"; exit 0
command -v workflow-lint >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec workflow-lint; [ -x "$HOME/.claude/hooks/workflow-lint" ] && exec "$HOME/.claude/hooks/workflow-lint"; exit 0
command -v delegation-gate >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec delegation-gate; [ -x "$HOME/.claude/hooks/delegation-gate" ] && exec "$HOME/.claude/hooks/delegation-gate"; exit 0
